source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC Web Overview, check Network information, then select `View more` and check details.
source_snapshot.criteria: All information should match the SPEC definition.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES reads a fixed Manager EthernetInterfaces collection, may return only member links, assumes ManagerId `bmc`, narrows all fields to IP/MAC and bypasses both UI views.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION adds interface disambiguation, DHCP/VLAN/address-family semantics, UI/API mapping, no-edit boundary and recovery.

old_problem: The historical record established a safe per-interface comparison but retained Pending for the physical/shared/dedicated/failover map, complete field/value semantics, Manager/member mapping and alternate recovery.
disposition_reason: The source clearly requires all Overview and View-more Network information to match SPEC without configuration changes. Exact management paths, interface roles, current/configured addresses and topology are Project inputs. The Review layer requires Manager discovery, member traversal, stable interface-role binding and address origin/lifetime/VLAN context rather than flat IP/MAC comparison. ED-05 keeps Ethernet identity separate from IB, ED-15 requires the signed field matrix, ED-20 preserves all interfaces/fields, ED-35 rejects API-only substitution, and ED-38 enforces no-edit/no-retry plus alternate recovery.
decision_basis: XLSX row 855, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly reviewed.
A BMC may expose dedicated, shared, sideband, virtual and failover interfaces simultaneously; array order or current URL cannot establish interface identity.
Network correctness includes address family, origin, prefix, lifetime, VLAN, gateway/DNS/hostname/link context as selected by the signed Project matrix, not bare IP/MAC strings.
Information observation authorizes no edit, apply, renew, release, reset, enable/disable or failover operation.

test_case.test_name: Verify all BMC Overview and View-more network fields against the signed interface/topology SPEC
test_case.purpose: Prove every Project-required BMC management interface shown in Overview and `View more` maps to the correct physical/shared/dedicated/sideband/virtual/failover role and displays current and configured MAC, address, VLAN, link and related network semantics matching the signed Project specification, without affecting connectivity.
required_package: Exact BMC/controller/certificate, firmware/WebUI build, current management path and independently verified alternate OOB recovery
Signed physical-port to interface-role map for dedicated/shared/sideband/virtual/failover paths with stable IDs and permanent/current MAC expectations
Per-interface expected IPv4/IPv6, DHCP/static origin, prefix/mask, gateway, DNS, VLAN, hostname/FQDN, link, speed and address-lifetime fields as applicable
Overview/View-more labels, order, role visibility, locale/format, selector/route and page-ready contract
Discovered Manager and EthernetInterfaces collection/member/OEM mappings without fixed IDs
Trusted TLS, protected authentication, sensitive address redaction, no-edit/no-apply interlock and reachability observer
test_case.test_command: Establish BMC identity, current access path and alternate OOB recovery. Discover the target Manager from `/redfish/v1/Managers`, then GET its EthernetInterfaces collection and every in-scope member/OEM detail through trusted read-only access. Independently bind each member to its physical/virtual role using stable ID, permanent/current MAC, topology and Project evidence. Capture Overview first, activate only the exact `View more` navigation once, and record every required UI field without entering edit mode. Produce a per-interface comparison of UI summary, UI detail, member/OEM data and signed SPEC including current/configured address, origin, family, prefix, lifetime, VLAN, gateway/DNS/hostname/link/speed as applicable. Record stale/temporary/failover/link-down/permission-filtered values separately. Do not edit/apply/reset/renew/release/fail over, clear logs, refresh state or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The BMC and every required interface are correctly identity-bound. Overview and View more account for every signed-matrix field and interface with correct role, MAC/address configuration and required link/network semantics at acceptable freshness. Current and configured/transient/failover values are classified correctly, no unintended or unapproved entry is hidden, management reachability is unchanged and no network operation is submitted.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires trusted BMC identity, verified current/alternate paths, complete physical/role map, both UI views, every in-scope member and 100% accounted signed field matrix with correct origin/lifetime/context and engineer verdict. A fixed `/Managers/bmc` path, first member, current URL, collection envelope, IP/MAC-only dump or API-only evidence cannot pass. Wrong/missing/extra interface, role mismatch, incorrect/stale address semantics, unexpected failover/link state, permission filtering contrary to matrix, UI/API mismatch or any edit/apply request is FAIL. Missing topology/matrix/mapping/recovery is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Do not edit, apply, reset, enable/disable, renew/release, fail over or change IP, DHCP, VLAN, route, DNS or hostname.
Discover Manager and all in-scope members; do not assume ManagerId `bmc`, the first member or current URL represents the only interface.
Treat collections as discovery and retain origin, family, prefix, lifetime, VLAN and link context for every address.
Validate TLS, protect credentials and retain a separately verified alternate OOB recovery path before opening a configuration-capable page.
Never clear BMC/network/system/audit logs or trigger refresh/renew solely to make values current; use timestamps/lease metadata.
Navigate once and stop on reachability change, edit mode, apply request, wrong-interface mapping, transient failover, identity mismatch or ambiguous stale data; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: BMC/controller identity, firmware/WebUI build, trusted certificate, current management path and alternate OOB recovery
Signed physical-port/interface-role map and per-interface field/value/semantics matrix
Redacted Overview and View-more DOM/screenshots/routes with role, locale, page-ready state and timestamps
Discovered Manager URI, EthernetInterfaces collection and every in-scope member/OEM payload including stable ID, permanent/current MAC, address family/origin/lifetime, VLAN, link and required fields
Per-interface UI-summary/UI-detail/API/SPEC comparison covering missing, extra, stale, temporary, failover, link-down and permission-filtered values
Proof no edit/apply/renew/reset request or reachability change occurred, preserved audit logs and authorized engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. If edit/apply is invoked or reachability changes, stop all WebUI/network actions, preserve the request/time and use only the pre-verified alternate OOB path plus the Project network recovery procedure to assess/restore access. Do not guess or automatically reapply network settings, renew leases or force failover.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define a read-only Network information comparison in Overview and View more; exact fields/topology are Project inputs.

blocked.reason: The information-display comparison is clear; interface topology, field semantics, resource mapping and recovery are supplyable prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: BMC/UI identity, current/alternate paths, full physical/interface-role and field/value matrix, Manager/EthernetInterface/OEM mapping, freshness/transient rules and redaction.
